summary: Static review of the exact PR head (258a63faf...) found no defect attributable to this change. New team-worker-heartbeat.ts is self-contained (non-overlapping writes via #inFlight guard, unref'd timer, disposed/idempotent lifecycle). Wiring in agent-session.ts starts/stops the reporter around turn lifecycle and disposes on session dispose, gated to top-level sessions only (taskDepth 0) to avoid N subagents writing the same record. team-launch.ts propagates GJC_TEAM_HEARTBEAT_STALE_MS into worker panes since tmux does not inherit launching-shell env. Docs (environment-variables.md, team SKILL.md, CHANGELOG.md) are consistent with the code change.
